name: The Solstice
objective: The cult begins its solstice ceremony at the summit with the five bells it holds. Climb through the procession and take them back.
intro: A river of crimson-robed faithful winds up the mountain, singing. At its head, five bells swing in a frame of black ice.
dialogue: Echo Priest Maltheus: "You cannot stop a lullaby. You can only choose what wakes up."
Echo Priest Maltheus (defeated): "Then you will meet it awake. May your winter be long."
lore_discovery: The priest's fifth bell is seized mid-ceremony — but the ringing has already begun. Something below has noticed.
